name: minimal-chat-agent
title: Minimal Chat Agent
description: A source-backed minimal AI SDK agent with OpenAI hosted web search, public GitHub repository lookup, and questionnaire-driven human-in-the-loop tool output.
docs: Install into a Next.js App Router project initialized with shadcn/ui. This item installs a minimal tool-calling chat route with OpenAI hosted web search, public GitHub lookup, and a questionnaire that returns human answers into the same agent loop. Add authentication and rate limiting before exposing the consumer route publicly.
